raw:
Ralf Schumacher had **one** second-or-third-place finish in 2006: 3rd at the Australian Grand Prix (round 3), where he started 6th.

I checked the top-10 results for all 18 rounds. He appears in the top 10 at Australia (3rd), Malaysia (8th), San Marino (9th), Monaco (8th), France (4th), Germany (9th), Hungary (6th), Turkey (7th), the United States (retired) and Japan (7th). The Bahrain, Spain, European, Canadian, British, Italian and Chinese results I retrieved don't list him in the top 10, and the Brazilian top 10 I retrieved doesn't list him either. That means he finished outside the top 10 in those races, so none of them were second or third places. I did not separately confirm his finishing position at Bahrain, Canada, China and Brazil, since the top-10 lists I retrieved don't show him, but none of those could be a podium.

ANSWER: 1
